How this simulation works +

A simulated Alexa+ conversation, with a real scheduler. SupperShift interprets a bounded set of kitchen phrases using rules, computes a browser-local cooking schedule, and keeps your demo state on this device. It uses a demo clock; it does not detect your appliances, food, or cooking progress.

This prototype has no connection to real Alexa+, sensors, or a cloud AI API. You review changes before applying them. Optional browser speech features may use your browser provider’s online service; typing works without speech. The illustrated meal and timings are demonstration data, not food-safety guidance.
